why: Mechanics need quick answers on workshop tablets without everyone having a Claude seat, and answers should link to the fleet system.
knowledge: Manufacturer workshop manuals and service schedules (check the licence allows this use).
Council fleet maintenance procedures and safe work procedures (Word / PDF).
Fault history and past work orders from the fleet management system.
Recall notices and technical service bulletins.

technical: Move the prototype into an Azure DevOps repo and rebuild the front end in Vue and Bootstrap, hosted on Azure App Service with council (Entra ID) sign-in.
Move all AI calls into an Azure Function App, with Claude through Microsoft Foundry or the council's Anthropic agreement. Keys live in Key Vault, never in the page.
Strip or pseudonymise personal information before anything goes to the model.
Load the knowledge into an Azure AI Search index over the source documents in Blob Storage, so answers can quote their source.
Show it on workshop tablets in a simple, glove-friendly layout.
Send flagged gaps to the knowledge owner automatically (for example a SharePoint list or Planner task) instead of the copied gap report.
Link answers to the vehicle's history and open work orders in the fleet management system.
Security review against the OWASP Top 10 and the OWASP Top 10 for LLM apps (including prompt injection).
Dev, Test and Prod resource groups in the council's Azure subscription.
Azure App Service (front end) and Azure Function App (AI and data calls).
Key Vault, Application Insights logging and cost alerts.
Blob Storage and Azure AI Search for the knowledge, or SQL / Cosmos DB for working data.
Model access: a Claude deployment in Microsoft Foundry or an enterprise Anthropic API key (needs an ICT-DA exception as it's outside the listed stack).
Entra ID app registration and a security group for who can use it.
Azure DevOps repo and CI/CD pipelines for Dev, Test and Prod.
Read access to the fleet management system (through Boomi or Logic Apps).
Workshop tablets on the council network.
business: Confirm the business owner, scope and success measures, and raise an Azure DevOps card (why and how).
Build a test plan and an AI evaluation set (real-style questions with expected answers), then run UAT with synthetic or anonymised data.
Name a knowledge owner who keeps the source documents current and approved.
Agree how fast the knowledge owner answers flagged gaps, and check the fault code guides for every fleet model are loaded.
Train the people who will use it, and set up support: who to ask and how to report a wrong answer.
Get ICT-DA, CAB, PGG and Business System Owner approval, with a Go Live plan, service transition document and support playbook.

technical: Set it up as a Claude Project for workshop leads in the council's enterprise Claude, with the prototype's instructions as the project instructions.
Add the knowledge as project files, or connect the SharePoint library it lives in so it stays current.
Admin settings checked: data retention, sharing and connector permissions.
business: Confirm the business owner, who will use it and what it must never do (it drafts, a person decides).
Organise manuals by make and model so answers stay on the right vehicle.
Agree how mechanics report gaps and how fast the knowledge owner adds the missing procedure or spec.
Test it with 20 to 30 real-style cases and record how often it gets them right.
Pilot with a small group, give them a 30-minute walkthrough, and collect feedback for two to four weeks.
Enterprise Claude seats for everyone who will use it.
A project owner who keeps the instructions and knowledge up to date.
The knowledge in a controlled SharePoint library (approved versions only), plus the Microsoft 365 connector if it's connecting live.
Clear rules on what information can be entered (no unnecessary personal information).
Claude seats or shared access for workshop leads (fewer seats, so not every mechanic).
Get the use case approved (ICT-DA and PGG) and confirm privacy settings before rolling it out wider.

stakeholders.detail: Ticket 328505: Mechanic knowledge-base agent. Plant Fleet, City Fleet, Transport Services. Asked for: "Mechanic tool - knowledge base agent for maintenance". Triage: Unable to determine.
Owns the process, agrees what good looks like and signs off going live.
Keep the documents the tool relies on current and approved.
Builds the solution, runs testing and hands over to support.

stakeholders.who: ICT-DA, CAB, PGG and the Business System Owner
stakeholders.detail: Approve the design, the change and going live.
